title: Container Bookings: admission checks for a new booking request
content:
## Policy clause
Under the Container Bookings product line, a booking request is admitted to a tier only when the request itself fits the tier:
1. the channel is one of the tier's allowed channels;
2. the cargo category is one of its allowed cargo categories;
3. the container count does not exceed the tier's maximum containers per booking;
4. the requested departure (ETD) lies no more than the tier's booking window in calendar days after the request date;
5. the request is received at least the tier's minimum lead time, in hours, before the cargo cut-off of the requested sailing.

The customer's credit standing must not be credit hold; only cash in advance and credit approved are acceptable, as shown on the customer's profile in the line's records at the time of the request.

## Spot or contract rating
Spot and contract rating are mutually exclusive on one booking. A tier whose contract reference is not allowed (AHL Spot Saver, AHL Spot Flex) must carry no service contract; a tier whose contract is required (AHL Contract Booking, AHL Contract Priority) must reference a service contract; AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express may be booked either way. When a contract is referenced:
- the referenced service contract must be in status active;
- it must be held by the requesting customer and cover the same trade lane as the booking;
- its tier rank must be at least the booking tier's minimum contract tier rank, so AHL Contract Priority is open only to holders of an AHL Key Account Contract or higher;
- the scheduled departure must fall on or before the expiry date of the referenced service contract.

Each contract condition is judged on the referenced contract's own record in the line's system, not on the customer's description of it.

## Handling of a failed check
A request failing any condition is declined through the confirmation process without charge. The desk may offer another tier whose conditions the request meets, but never places it in a different tier without the customer's instruction.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)
*Hypothetical tier settings, for illustration only.*
- Booking window of 30 days, request dated 1 March: an ETD of 31 March lies exactly 30 calendar days after the request date and fits; an ETD of 1 April does not.
- Minimum lead of 36 hours, cargo cut-off at 18:00 on 10 May: a request received at 06:00 on 9 May is exactly 36 hours ahead and fits; one received at 06:30 does not.
- Contract expiring on 15 August: a sailing scheduled to depart on 15 August may be booked under it; one departing on 16 August may not.

## Points of judgement
**A spot customer wants AHL Spot Flex but quotes a service contract.** The request cannot carry a contract on that tier; with a contract reference it does not fit AHL Spot Flex.

**The request fits AHL Contract Booking but the customer asked for AHL Contract Priority and holds only a lower-ranked contract.** The request is declined for AHL Contract Priority; the desk may offer AHL Contract Booking but places the booking there only on the customer's instruction.
